title: Ultimate DayCounter
description: A fully customizable day-counter datapack with an interactive dialog GUI, animated bossbar/actionbar, live progress, and new-day celebrations.
body:
# Ultimate Day Counter

![SHOWCASE](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/de6f1fd70717775c14873a1dc8fdf72a719e91cf_0.webp)


A colorful, animated Minecraft day-counter datapack with a proper dialog GUI. It tracks the in-game day and shows it with rich colors, a live progress bar, an animated spinner, a new-day celebration, and an interactive menu, all without any required operator commands.

## Features

- **Color-coded bossbar**: a time-of-day progress bar that changes color by phase.
- **Animated actionbar**: a rotating spinner whose color cycles, next to the live day number and a filling progress bar that mirrors the bossbar.
- **New-day celebration**: a title and subtitle animation with fireworks particles and a launch sound at the start of every day.
- **Dialog GUI**: open an interactive panel with buttons for a live day readout, help, HUD mode (Both / Bossbar / Actionbar / Hide)

## Usage

Type these in chat (no cheats or operator required):

```
/trigger daymenu     # open the Day Counter GUI panel
/trigger daytoggle   # show / hide the HUD (bossbar + actionbar)
```


## Example Uses

- **YouTubers**: let viewers see the current day of your survival series.
- **Challenge runs**: track days survived without building a clock.
- **Casual players**: celebrate milestones and watch the day roll by.

## Installation

1. Put the `Ultimate DayCounter` folder or .zip file into your world's `datapacks/` directory.
